'''Nolaa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] figure in the mythology of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Nolaa was the faithful [[Reproduction/Legends|daughter]] of the famous maternal figure [[Mala (mythical figure)|Mala]].<ref name="GCG" /> [[Nolaa Tarkona]], the leader of the [[Diversity Alliance]] in the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|post-Imperial era]],<ref name="YJK:DA">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Diversity Alliance]]''</ref> was among the Twi'lek females that had the name Nolaa.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nolaa was first mentioned in the [[2003]] supplement book ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', written by [[J.D. Wiker]] and [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="GCG" />
